issues.effect_attachment_limit: {{effect}} was removed: at most {{limit}} body, sticker or silhouette effects can show at once.

issues.effect_overlay_required: {{effect}} needs overlay mode on this face.
issues.effect_placement_failed: {{effect}} could not be placed on this Avatar.
issues.effect_skin_color_unavailable: {{effect}} could not sample the face skin color for its backdrop.
issues.effect_surface_too_dark: {{effect}} was skipped: it darkens the face where it is painted, and the face there is too dark for the change to show.
issues.effect_target_incompatible: {{effect}} does not fit the part it was placed on.
issues.effect_target_unknown: {{effect}} names a model part that does not exist.
issues.effect_target_unresolved: {{effect}} found no compatible part on this Avatar.
issues.effect_unknown: An effect is not available in this installation.
issues.eye_detail_not_hidden: {{effect}} plays, but the {{part, lowercase}} inside a shared mesh part could not be hidden.
issues.face_expressions_none: This Avatar has no face shapes for moods (no VRoid parts, MMD morphs, ARKit shapes or mood presets), so its face stays neutral; moods show through motion and effects.
issues.face_parts_correction_digest_unknown: The saved face part correction was ignored because this file's digest is unknown.
issues.face_parts_correction_invalid: The saved face part correction could not be read and was ignored.
issues.face_parts_correction_other_file: The saved face part correction was made for a different file and was ignored.
issues.face_parts_correction_schema_unsupported: The saved face part correction uses an unsupported format and was ignored.

issues.face_parts_detection_failed: Face parts could not be detected, so effects are placed by material names.
issues.face_parts_expressions_missing: The model’s blink or “aa” expression moves no mesh (it is missing, or only switches materials), and no MMD, ARKit or VRChat shapes stand in for it, so its face skin and eye details cannot be found from them.
issues.face_parts_whole_body_head_missing: One mesh part holds the whole body, but no forward-facing part of it skinned to the head bone moves when the model blinks or opens its mouth, so its face cannot be found and Avatar Effects on the face are skipped.
issues.file_unavailable: The Avatar file could not be downloaded.
issues.file_unreadable: The Avatar file is not a readable glTF or VRM file.
issues.humanoid_bones_remapped_one: {{count}} humanoid bone pointed at a bone that moves no part of the model, so Animama uses the bone beside it that the mesh follows.
issues.humanoid_bones_remapped_other: {{count}} humanoid bones pointed at bones that move no part of the model, so Animama uses the bones beside them that the mesh follows.
issues.humanoid_bones_unweighted_one: {{count}} humanoid bone moves no part of the model, and no bone beside it that the mesh follows could replace it, so motion on it does not show.
issues.humanoid_bones_unweighted_other: {{count}} humanoid bones move no part of the model, and no bones beside them that the mesh follows could replace them, so motion on them does not show.
issues.iris_hide_unavailable: Content asked to hide the irises (Fcl_EYE_Iris_Hide), but no iris mesh part of this Avatar can be hidden: none was found, or it shares a mesh part with the face skin.
issues.landmarks_anchor_missing: No head was found to anchor face landmarks.
issues.landmarks_eyes_missing: No eyes were found on the face, so eye effects are unavailable.
issues.landmarks_face_bounds_failed: The face skin could not be measured.
issues.landmarks_face_skin_missing: No face skin was found, so face landmarks are unavailable.
issues.materials_unlit: Every material in this file ignores light, so it looks flat as made. Animama adds toon shading and outlines unless the Avatar's Materials setting is Simple.
issues.morph_target_names_mismatched_one: {{count}} mesh stores shape key names that disagree with each other or with its shape keys, so those shape keys stay unnamed and any MMD morphs or ARKit shapes among them cannot be used.
issues.morph_target_names_mismatched_other: {{count}} meshes store shape key names that disagree with each other or with their shape keys, so those shape keys stay unnamed and any MMD morphs or ARKit shapes among them cannot be used.
issues.scene_bindings_unavailable: The loaded model's mesh parts could not be listed.
issues.springs_helper_failed: A spring bone guide could not be drawn.
issues.springs_metadata_missing: The file has no spring bone settings, so springs move at half strength.
issues.springs_source_unavailable: The file's spring bone data could not be read, so springs use default settings.
issues.springs_unmapped_joints_one: {{count}} spring joint could not be matched to the file's spring data.
issues.springs_unmapped_joints_other: {{count}} spring joints could not be matched to the file's spring data.
